column4: An old leather wallet is pulled open: the soft creak of worn leather and a small rattle of coins inside, close up, a quiet shop
A worn leather wallet folded shut with a soft leather pat and a muffled rattle of coins, close up
A single coin put down on a rubber change mat on a shop counter, one dull little click and a short wobble, close, dry, no ring
One soft worn paper banknote laid flat on a rubber mat on a counter, a small crisp papery rustle, close up
A hand sweeps a few coins and a banknote off a rubber mat on a shop counter and gathers them up, a short scrape and a clink of coins in the fingers
A shopkeeper counts out three coins one after another onto a rubber change mat on a counter, three separate dull clicks with short pauses, close, a quiet shop
A few coins slid across a counter and dropped into a leather wallet's coin pouch, a soft slide and a muffled clink, close up
One key pressed on an old heavy mechanical cash register, a single short dry metal clack, close, a quiet shop
A small glass bottle set down firmly on a laminate shop counter, one short glassy knock, close, a quiet shop
A small matchbox tossed lightly on a laminate counter, a dry light tap and the small rattle of matches inside it, close
A round loaf of bread set down on a shop counter, a soft dull crusty thud, close, a quiet shop
A folded thin newspaper dropped flat on a shop counter, a short papery slap, close, a quiet shop
A soft paper pack of cigarettes put down on a laminate counter, a small dry papery tap, close
Something small is picked up off a laminate shop counter, a light scrape and a soft lift, close, a quiet shop
A person tears a piece off a hard crusted rye loaf with their teeth and chews it a few times, the crust cracking, close, dry, no voice
The crown cap of a small glass bottle of fizzy cola levered off with a dull pop and a soft short hiss of gas, close up
A person takes three quick gulps from a glass bottle of fizzy cola, fizz in the bottle, then a short breath out, close, no voice
A wooden match struck once on the side of a matchbox: a dry scrape, the sulphur flaring with a soft hiss, a small flame burning, close, a quiet room
A small match flame pinched out between the fingers, a soft short puff and a tiny sizzle, close
A thin cheap newspaper unfolded and shaken open with both hands, soft dry newsprint rustle, close up, a quiet room
A thin newspaper folded in half and put down, a soft rustle and a short pat, close up
